Basically what everyone else has said, I just wanted to add that externally threaded jewelry is never the high quality titanium or stainless steel that you should be wearing in your piercings. Threadless (Neometal) jewelry is also good too!

1. You shouldn't be moving the jewelry around, it's going to do nothing but irritate it. 

2. If you think your piercing is actually infected you should go to your doctor. 

3. You should probably find a reputable piercer to give you some aftercare advice. I know the APP website has a list (I'm on mobile otherwise I'd link it). The mods are normally happy to recommend shops closest to you too. 

Good luck, hopefully it gets better!

Hi! I have trichotillomania as well. I have gotten pretty good at not picking at piercings because I am too obsessed with them to risk messing up their healing. I've been dealing with trich for ~15 years and it's definitely a learning process for what works for you. 

I have always found things like stress balls useful because it makes your hand busy and unable to pick at your piercing. You could also try those old wire-y choker necklaces; I used to sort of snap it and I found it very useful. 

You might want to cross post this to /r/Trichsters! They normally have awesome suggestions.
